key_insight: A hybrid quantum-classical ensemble using QSVM and VQC can improve phishing detection on Ethereum transaction networks, with QSVM showing the strongest anomaly-detection recall and lowest false negatives.
engineering_relevance: The study suggests quantum machine learning can add value to security analytics pipelines for blockchain fraud detection, especially where minimizing missed attacks is critical.
method: Train QSVM and VQC on real Ethereum transaction network data
Compare QRAC-based data encoding against the ZZ feature map
Evaluate models on simulators and the IBM Heron quantum processor
evidence_signal: QRAC improved performance over ZZ by 13% for VQC and 3% for QSVM, and QSVM consistently achieved the lowest false negatives with higher recall.
watch_item: Performance still trails leading deep learning methods, and hardware results depend on the availability and quality of high-volume quantum devices.
paper_title: Detecting Phishing in Ethereum Networks using Quantum Machine Learning
